notes: The two questions the operator's standing instructions of 2026-10-29 ask every project to put to them once (docs/operator-protocol.md section 1.3).
answer is null until the operator answers, then true or false; recorded is the date the answer was written here. The session-start hook names every question whose answer is null.
Until autonomy is true, sessions propose the next session as a card. Until ste100 is true, prose follows the persona's section 14.1.

ste100.question: Should replies and project documentation follow ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, unless a deliverable says otherwise?

autonomy.question: May sessions work autonomously: start the next session themselves with the model and effort set, keep docs/status.md current, and report rather than ask?
